notes: BUU 2.0 v2.2.7 - new Frankware-only step that scrapes every order for an account across all pages of the Orders table and writes one CSV row per order (Order Id, Service, Status, Price, Balance, Write-off), stamped with PP Location Code, PP Invoice #, and Frankware Property #. Balance keeps its sign (negative = still owed). Output is one deduplicated CSV in the run's results folder, written as the run goes (crash-safe). The step appears only when a Frankware login profile is selected, and a new persistent run setting toggles CSV output (uncheck for a dry run).
